questions.title: Which theme should the app use by default?

options.label: Light
options.description: A bright interface with dark text on light backgrounds. Familiar, high contrast in well-lit rooms, and the conventional default for most apps.

options.label: Dark
options.description: A dim interface with light text on dark backgrounds. Easier on the eyes at night and can save power on OLED displays.

questions.title: Which features should be included in the first release?

options.label: Search
options.description: Full-text search across the user's content, with filters and keyboard-driven navigation.

options.label: Export
options.description: Export data to common formats such as CSV, JSON, or PDF for use outside the app.
